Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. This looks like a Coverity false positive rather than a real defect: osp_current_object_update_request() cannot return NULL for the `our` used here, so the new branch is unreachable and the patch adds dead code plus a Fixes: tag that will pull an unnecessary cherry-pick into the maintenance branches. If the intent is to make the invariant explicit rather than to fix a crash, that is worth saying out loud, and it should be done consistently with OSP_UPDATE_RPC_PACK() in osp_internal.h, which LASSERTs on exactly the same condition.

commit.subject: LU-17000 osp: Fix deref in osp_insert_async_request()
commit.message:
LU-17000 osp: Fix deref in osp_insert_async_request()

osp_current_object_update_request() may return NULL
(empty list). However, it can never be empty for a
live osp_update_request. This patch handles this by
adding an explicit LASSERT() to handle edge case.

CoverityID: 397298 ("Dereference null return value")
Fixes: 044fbff00b2 ("LU-3534 osp: transfer updates with bulk RPC")
Signed-off-by: Arshad Hussain <arshad.hussain@aeoncomputing.com>
Change-Id: I0e5da3dfb8a18b1338405a6fbd7d6377129ddbb7
